Order 
This is second application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.36/2024 registered at Police Station Mahila Thana District Rewa (M.P.) for the offences under Sections 376, 506 of IPC & Section 5/6 of POCSO Act and Sections 3(1)(w)(ii), 3(2)(v) of SC & ST (POA) Act.

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since more than 11/2 years.
Prosecutrix has been examined in Court and she is hostile.
Considering the long period of custody and facts of the case, applicant may be released on bail.
3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application for grant of bail.

4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5.

Considering the period of custody and the fact that prosecutrix has NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024:MPHC-JBP:55678 2 MCRC-44750-2024 already been examined and she is hostile, bail application filed by applicant i s allowed.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rs. Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like Prashant Chaube vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/125771126/
1 amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his regular appearance before Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of trial.
